FX-MOSAIC-001.says: The settings as they start, size 10: two blocks across, columns 0 to 9 and a block cut short at the right edge, columns 10 to 15, each the full height and one flat colour, the mean of its pixels; both are partly empty, so both come out partly covered, the left 63.5 of its 100 pixels' worth, the right 33 of its 60, and the frame keeps each channel's total.

FX-MOSAIC-002.says: Size 1, the least: one-pixel blocks, and the drawing untouched.

FX-MOSAIC-003.says: Size 2: blocks of two by two, eight across and five down; the soft edge down column 3 is averaged with the empty column 2 beside it, to a quarter covering.

FX-MOSAIC-004.says: Size 4: blocks of four by four, the bottom row of blocks cut short to rows 8 and 9; a block all of skin, columns 4 to 7 and rows 0 to 3, stays skin; the empty top right block stays empty; the top left block, empty but for four soft pixels, is skin at a quarter of their half covering.

FX-MOSAIC-005.says: Size 3: 16 and 10 are each one more than a multiple of 3, so column 15 and row 9 are blocks one pixel wide, and the corner pixel (15, 9), a block of its own, is exactly the drawing's white.

FX-MOSAIC-006.says: Size 2.5, part of a pixel: the blocks are three and two pixels wide by turns, columns 0 to 2, 3 and 4, 5 to 7, 8 and 9, 10 to 12, 13 and 14, and 15 alone; rows 0 to 2, 3 and 4, 5 to 7, 8 and 9.

FX-MOSAIC-007.says: Size 16, the drawing's width: one block, the whole frame, every pixel the drawing's mean colour at its mean covering.

FX-MOSAIC-008.says: Size 1000, the most: the same single block as size 16, FX-MOSAIC-007.

FX-MOSAIC-009.says: Size 8: two blocks across, columns 0 to 7 and 8 to 15, and two down, rows 0 to 7 and a short row of blocks, rows 8 and 9, which are the white strip's and its empty start, so the bottom left block is white at half covering and the bottom right white.

FX-MOSAIC-010.says: Size keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-MOSAIC-003, frame 2 is size 4, FX-MOSAIC-004, and frame 4 size 6.

FX-MOSAIC-011.says: Size keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4, eased past its end: at frame 2 it would pass 1000, is held at 1000, and is FX-MOSAIC-008, as frame 4 is; frame 0 is the drawing untouched.

FX-MOSAIC-012.says: Size 4, the layer moved three pixels right: FX-MOSAIC-004 moved; the blocks are laid from the drawing's own corner, so they move with it, and the three columns left of it stay empty.

FX-MOSAIC-013.says: A directional blur, direction 90 and length 4, then size 4: the blur grew the layer two pixels on every side, and the blocks are still laid from the drawing's own corner, not the grown layer's, so the blocks in the frame are FX-MOSAIC-004's, averaged from the blurred pixels, and the bottom row of blocks, rows 8 to 11, takes in the two grown rows below the frame, which the sideways blur left empty, so it comes out half as covered as rows 8 and 9 are.

FX-MOSAIC-014.says: Size 10.5: blocks columns 0 to 10 and 11 to 15, rows 0 to 9 one block: the part of a pixel moves the block's edge past column 10.

FX-MOSAIC-015.says: Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MOSAIC-016.says: Size 0.5, below 1 by half a pixel. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MOSAIC-017.says: Size -10, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MOSAIC-018.says: Size 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MOSAIC-019.says: Size keyed to 1500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MOSAIC-020.says: Size keyed to 0 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
